# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.4.3

This testing version fixes Agent-registration cleanup and retains the business-focused onboarding introduced in v0.4.2. No tag or GitHub Release has been created for it.

## Highlights

- Records the actual Codex/Claude Code client path, the complete MCP command and arguments, and installer ownership without storing an API Key. Uninstall and online doctor can locate clients outside the current PATH.
- Compares complete commands and arguments before cleanup. Claude removal is restricted to user scope; manual registrations, other Agents and unrelated MCP entries are preserved.
- Explicitly reports pending Agent cleanup rather than claiming a complete uninstall. A matching registration removal failure stops cleanup before program deletion. Keeping a pre-existing or shared PATH is informational.
- Handles the UTF-8 BOM produced by Windows PowerShell 5.1 pipelines when registering MCP. Chinese installation paths, strict version validation and SHA-256 checks remain supported.
- Retains first-use onboarding, Windows DPAPI migration, two-stage uploads and one-shot paid-submission protection. No public commands or MCP tools are added.

## Installation and update

Installers replace the program at the same prefix after validating downloads. Managed files are temporarily backed up and restored on failed post-install checks; successful installation removes the temporary backup. Local credentials, attempts, upload plans and user settings are preserved. The CLI does not keep two runnable versions side by side.

The stable entrypoints still install the latest published release, not this testing branch. Test users must use a verified fixed commit with `HOLYCRAB_INSTALL_REF`. This version is not merged to main or deployed to the website.

## Verification

Tests use mocks, temporary installations and read-only Generate source. No production tasks, authorizations, uploads, renames or online deletions are performed. Upgrade fixtures cover v0.4.0, v0.4.1 and v0.4.2. Native PowerShell 5.1 tests execute the pinned colleague command and check delayed self-deletion within 10 seconds. Real beginner conversations remain a separate manual acceptance check.
